Documentation-only link update. Most targets resolve correctly: docs.cloud-init.io and canonical.com/maas (previously maas.io) are the current canonical homes, canonical.com/multipass is the live Multipass landing page, and ubuntu.com/enterprise-store/docs/ serves the Enterprise Store docs. The internal link /how-to-guides/manage-machines.md in deploy-dpus.md targets an existing file and matches the established internal-link convention used throughout the docs. However, one change in logging.md replaces a working URL with a broken one, which is directly contrary to the PR's stated goal of resolving broken references.

docs/reference/configuration-guides/logg.16: The new URL https://wiki.ubuntu.com/IptablesHowTo returns HTTP 404 (confirmed by direct fetch). The 'IptablesHowTo' page lives on the Community Help Wiki at https://help.ubuntu.com/community/IptablesHowTo, not on wiki.ubuntu.com (which hosts e.g. /UncomplicatedFirewall). The original URL being replaced here was correct and still resolves, so this change introduces a broken link; revert it or point to the still-live help.ubuntu.com page.
